description: This file defines an interface and classes for managing VSOCK connections, including client and server variants, with methods for connecting, disconnecting, reading, writing, and handling asynchronous operations with JSON message support.

classes.name: VsockConnection
classes.description: Abstract base class providing an interface for VSOCK connections, including synchronous and asynchronous read/write operations and connection management.

classes.name: VsockClientConnection
classes.description: Concrete class implementing VsockConnection for client-side VSOCK communication.

classes.name: VsockServerConnection
classes.description: Concrete class implementing VsockConnection for server-side VSOCK communication, with server shutdown capability.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a VSOCK connection to a specified port and CID, optionally with a vhost user CID.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the VSOCK connection.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous connection attempt to the specified port and CID.

methods.name: SetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called upon disconnection.

methods.name: IsConnected_Unguarded
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active without locking mutexes.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection is active.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if there is data available to read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a single byte from the connection.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a provided vector.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data into a vector.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads specified amount of data.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message into a vector.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message into a new vector and returns it.

methods.name: ReadMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessage
methods.description: Reads a JSON message from the connection.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer to the connection.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a character array to the connection.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a vector to the connection.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a string as a message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a vector as a message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a JSON value as a message.

methods.name: WriteStrides
methods.description: Writes data with specified strides into the connection.

methods.name: ServerShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server connection.
